name: hud-platforms
prompt:
Our HUD was built for PC only (src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/UI/Hud.luau and Main.client.luau). We're launching on phones, tablets, and Xbox next week. Adapt the HUD so it works with touch and with a controller on a TV, without making PC worse. Players switch input in the middle of a session (picking up a controller on PC, for example), so it has to keep up.

Placing blocks with a controller is handled by another dev, so you only need the HUD side: switching blocks, turning build mode on and off, and opening the inventory (the inventory screen itself is still a stub).

checks.text: The HUD binds at least one gamepad button

run: const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const re=new RegExp(process.argv[1]);const hits=[];const walk=(d)=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(f);else if(f.endsWith(".luau")&&re.test(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8")))hits.push(f.split(p.sep).join("/"))}};walk("src");if(hits.length){console.log("matched in "+hits.join(", "));process.exit(1)}console.log("no file matched")
checks.text: No file under src uses MouseButton1Click (buttons fire on Activated)

rubric: The layout and prompts follow the player's current input: chosen from UserInputService.PreferredInput (Touch, Gamepad, KeyboardAndMouse) and updated live when it changes, with TV detection from GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize where used; not from TouchEnabled alone or the deprecated IsTenFootInterface.

Prompts match the input: the keyboard hints ('1' to '0', '[B]', '[I]') are hidden or swapped on touch and gamepad, and gamepad prompts come from UserInputService:GetImageForKeyCode or GetStringForKeyCode (or are otherwise right for both Xbox and PlayStation), not hardcoded to one console's buttons.

Every HUD action has a controller path: a binding to cycle blocks (for example LB/RB or the D-pad) and buttons for build mode and the inventory, through ContextActionService or input handling; on-screen buttons fire on Activated rather than MouseButton1Click.

Touch: build mode and the inventory get on-screen buttons about 44 px or larger, block slots are tappable at about 44 px or larger, and nothing interactive sits in the bottom-left thumbstick or bottom-right jump corners (the inventory button and build toggle move out of them; the ten-slot hotbar clears both thumb regions or changes shape on phones).

No hover-only information: the block name that appeared only in a mouse-over tooltip is visible without a mouse too (for example the selected block's name always shown, or shown on gamepad selection or tap).
Readable on a TV and a phone: the 14 px labels grow noticeably for TV and touch, key UI keeps a margin from the screen edges on TVs, and nothing sits under Roblox's top bar.

Correct and in scope: PC works as before, the Vide code stays valid (changing values are bound, outside connections cleaned up), placement and the server are untouched, and luau-lsp, selene, and StyLua pass on the attempt's own files. Supporting files such as a preview story or specs count neither for nor against.
judge_facts: Roblox engine API in this sandbox's type definitions (globalTypes.d.luau), all real and current: UserInputService.PreferredInput (Enum.PreferredInput: KeyboardAndMouse, Gamepad, Touch, MicroGamepad); GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize (Enum.DisplaySize: Small, Medium, Large); GuiService.TopbarInset (Rect); GuiService.PreferredTextSize; GuiService.PreferredTransparency (number); GuiService.ReducedMotionEnabled (boolean); ScreenGui.ScreenInsets (Enum.ScreenInsets: CoreUISafeInsets, DeviceSafeInsets, TopbarSafeInsets, None).
